text:
London gets much more rain than hot or dry cities such as Dubai (about 100 mm a year), Cairo (about 25 mm), Riyadh (about 100 mm), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), and Los Angeles (about 370 mm), while London averages roughly 600 mm. Madrid (about 440 mm) is also drier than London. These are approximate long-term averages, and I didn't check them against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 85
